correction.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the deprecated, misspelled `ruler.wal-cleaer.period` option; use `ruler.wal-cleaner.period` instead. Exposed: environments whose Loki workloads still pass the `-ruler.wal-cleaer.period` CLI flag.
